entities.name: Maximos V Hakim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maximos V Hakim was a Syrian Catholic prelate who served as Melkite Catholic Patriarch of Antioch from 1967 to 2000. He guided the Church through turbulent changes in the Middle East and rapid expansion in the Western hemisphere.
